description: This PHP class 'Key' encapsulates a cryptographic key string, providing secure memory handling (zeroing out sensitive data) and access methods. It is part of the AWS SDK cryptography polyfill, specifically designed to hide sensitive key material during debugging and ensure secure destruction.

classes.name: Key
classes.description: A class that wraps a cryptographic key string, providing mechanisms for secure destruction and retrieval of the key.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Key instance with a given string.

methods.name: __destruct
methods.description: Attempts to securely zero out the key from memory when the object is destroyed, using sodium_memzero if available.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns the stored cryptographic key string.

methods.name: length
methods.description: Returns the length of the key string, using mb_strlen if available, or strlen otherwise.
